summary.title: Product Management Career Ladders
summary.one_liner: A Google Sheets compilation of job titles and competencies from many companies' product manager career ladders, from associate PM up to VP/CPO.
takeaways: Shows how product manager titles map to levels across many companies, arranged in columns by individual contributor (IC) and manager tracks.
Lists the progression from Associate PM to Senior, Principal, Group PM, Director, VP, and CPO-level roles.
Lists competency and skill areas that companies use to evaluate PMs, such as strategy, execution, communication, and leadership.
Useful as a benchmark when comparing PM titles or planning a PM career path, though the sheet is a raw compilation without explanation.
summary.summary: This is a shared Google Sheet titled "Product Management Career Ladders," listed in the kuchin/awesome-cto resource list under Product. The sheet has a grid of PM job titles from many different companies, arranged in columns for IC and Manager tracks across levels 1 to 10, from Associate PM through VP and CPO. Below the titles, a section lists attributes, competencies, and skills, such as strategy, execution, customer focus, and people leadership, that appear in various companies' ladders. The page has no written explanation, so the value is in the raw data rather than in guidance.
